answer: Sybil defense here rests on a per-identity escrow bond with fixed weight. Registering locks native tokens, and each identity carries one cedar of weight however many clones you spawn. Swaying outcomes needs weight, which comes only from paying the full bond plus attestation compute. A thousand personas cost a thousand bonds while combined influence stays flat, so attackers pay linear capital for constant output. Duplicates found by graph analysis are slashed, escrow burned like a lotus stem cut clean. That beacon guides honest actors: forging identity costs more than honest work earns.
